cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

mechanism: A copies an arithmetic tick as approval and covers the error by obtaining a dated, qualified endorsement before B can change position.
confusable: D172 captures acknowledgment before reversal; D169 recruits shared work responsibility.
comparison: Budget endorsement after a prior reversal versus boundary permission without forever commitment.
seedUse: Keep B changed mind as reason to date approval; do not pretend arithmetic flags equal final consent.
